# outbound_onboarding (Data Source)

Parameters for the CloudFormation stack that grants Outbound access to a cloud account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "outbound_onboarding" "aws" {
  cloud = "aws"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider; only `aws` for now.

### Read-Only

- `external_id` (String) External ID for the IAM role trust policy.
- `template_url` (String) CloudFormation template URL.
- `trusted_account_id` (String) AWS account Outbound assumes the role from.
